propositions: Missing JIRA_PAT environment variable silently falls back to anonymous Jira access instead of failing with an explicit error naming the variable
Documentation promises that missing JIRA_PAT fails with a named error, but the code accepts an empty string token and constructs an anonymous client without validation
Empty or whitespace-only PAT values pass through to the Jira client as bearer tokens, causing requests to be treated as anonymous with misleading error messages about missing projects
Settings resolution must remain total and not raise on missing JIRA_PAT to avoid breaking Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks
Validation must occur at client construction time in build_client_from_settings before any network call, not during settings resolution
